newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post Front Page - Oct 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post Front Page - Oct 25.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Oct 25:
NEW ORLEANS - A frustrated Bob Dole lashed out at President Clinton, lambasted the "liberal media" and even took the voters to task by imploring, "Wake up America!"

WASHINGTON - Pope John Paul issued a statement this week saying new research shows that physical evolution is "more than just a theory", a significant step beyond the Catholic Church's pronouncement nearly 50 years ago.

MONTGOMERY, Ala. - For 35 years, Bob Dole honed his skills on Capitol Hill as one of Washington's best legislative tacticians and his campaign in these final months of his bid for the White House has resembled nothing so much as a mad scramble to broker a deal before adjournment.

WASHINGTON - Vice President Gore pressed his palms together in meditative style as he addressed a group of Asian Americans on April 29 at the Five Contemplations Hall of a Buddhist temple near Los Angeles. Now the event billed as "community outreach" has turned into a fund raising controversy for the Democratic Party.

WASHINGTON - Despite deep concerns about crime and the quality of schools, Prince George's County voters are reluctant to lift the property tax limit and provide leaders with the extra money they need to improve services.

WASHINGTON - To grasp just how complex and costly the computer world's Year 2000 problem is shaping up to be, you need go no further than a tiny federal office in Lanham, Md. where software experts are toiling to reprogram a mainframe computer that adminsiters flood insurance policies.
